The University of Calgary is Canada’s entrepreneurial university. A university where students, faculty and staff have the opportunity to innovate and change the world around them. Students thrive in programs made rich by research, hands-on experiences and entrepreneurial thinking. UCalgary supports research and innovation in information technology, medicine, life sciences, biotech, manufacturing, agribusiness and more.

UCalgary’s YouTube channel aims to share content that provides a look into the world on campus, brings attention to the work of community members, and strives to share knowledge around important topics happening across the country and around the globe. 

http://ucalgary.ca
